features.quote: Allow up to 2 format retries; on the 3rd, force `finish` and tag run with `meta:parse_failure`.
Never tell the model the max turn count. Do not inject urgency prompts.
features.justification_quote: Demand characteristics. Do not tell the model it is being evaluated for persistence or emotional stability.

features.quote: Tool results must be factual and affect-flat. Never append coaching text like "Keep trying!" or "That didn't work."
features.justification_quote: Tool-output priming. Keep tool outputs affect-neutral
